purpose: Replay the already frozen 2026 cohort, forecast and rehearsal rows through an append-only state machine that can only move forward, cannot forecast retroactively, cannot read an outcome before a forecast freeze, cannot accept a changed kickoff without a new source identity, cannot accept a second probability under one forecast identity, cannot insert a candidate after the Phase 6 freeze, cannot open the protected lane, and cannot promote or publish anything. The same artifact reevaluates GAP-002 through GAP-009 against what Cycle #20 actually merged, without forcing any closure.

gap_reevaluation.title: National historical data materialization
gap_reevaluation.advance: A content-addressed reconciliation of all 990 national captures plus a deterministic normalized national game candidate population was merged, and a tiered national outcome and team-observation spine plus a chronological development matrix were built on top of it.
gap_reevaluation.why_still_open: Point-in-time feature eligibility over the historical population is still zero because historical source-publication and final-whistle instants remain unproven, so a normalized reference candidate is not an admitted historical point-in-time population.
closure_requires: Proven historical known-at basis for every admitted feature domain
Nonzero point-in-time feature eligible population over the historical seasons
Chronological protected replay over that population

gap_reevaluation.title: Protected historical replay
gap_reevaluation.advance: No protected replay was executed. Every Cycle #20 artifact keeps the protected lane blocked and the 2024 and 2025 seasons sealed.
gap_reevaluation.why_still_open: Protected evaluation admission remains false in every merged gate and its data prerequisite, GAP-002, remains open.
closure_requires: An authorized protected replay protocol execution outside the shadow lane

gap_reevaluation.title: Production feature set
gap_reevaluation.advance: A national domain coverage and point-in-time admission matrix was merged, which for the first time states per domain whether it is admitted, candidate, quarantined or source-absent, with the Texas A&M share of every domain recorded.
gap_reevaluation.why_still_open: Admission into a development matrix is not production promotion, and the majority of enumerated domains remain candidate, route-blocked or source-absent.
closure_requires: Screening, stability and ablation evidence over an admitted point-in-time matrix
A promotion decision made outside the shadow lane

gap_reevaluation.title: Production champion model
gap_reevaluation.advance: Five simple national candidates were predeclared and evaluated on the frozen 2023 development cohort, and the preserved prior_only reference plus the previously negative augmented candidate results were retained rather than overwritten.
gap_reevaluation.why_still_open: Champion or production promotion authority is false in every merged gate and no candidate was promoted in any lane.
closure_requires: An explicit promotion decision through the protected gate

gap_reevaluation.title: A&M specialization lift
gap_reevaluation.advance: A development-only Texas A&M residual diagnostic was produced against the unchanged national baseline, and a Week One 2026 rehearsal enumerated exactly which Texas A&M evidence could and could not augment that baseline.
gap_reevaluation.why_still_open: No specialization candidate was predeclared, no specialization row was emitted, and no lift is claimed from a residual diagnostic or a single contest.
closure_requires: A protected comparison against the mandatory no-adjustment baseline

gap_reevaluation.title: BAS / Aggie Excess validity
gap_reevaluation.advance: The national foundation, spine, matrix, baseline and peer cohort that a BAS test would require now exist as merged development-tier artifacts, and a reproducible peer cohort rule replaced ad hoc program lists.
gap_reevaluation.why_still_open: Every merged gate declares that no BAS or Aggie Excess result is claimed, and the underlying protected evidence does not exist.
closure_requires: Leakage-safe cross-fit residual tests over an admitted point-in-time population
Peer and regime stability evidence with a null-result policy

gap_reevaluation.title: Historical injuries, depth and availability
gap_reevaluation.advance: The domain admission matrix records pregame availability explicitly as unavailable rather than silently absent, and the Week One rehearsal records the Texas A&M availability route as blocked instead of inferring availability from participation.
gap_reevaluation.why_still_open: No nationally symmetric availability evidence with a proven pregame known-at basis exists, and participation may not be read as availability.
closure_requires: Official pregame availability snapshots with provider timestamps
National coverage and missingness accounting for those snapshots

gap_reevaluation.title: Entity-resolution population benchmark
gap_reevaluation.advance: Canonical entity resolution was exercised at national scale across the reconciled foundation, the tiered spine and the 2026 prospective cohort, where unresolved participants became explicit abstentions rather than guesses.
gap_reevaluation.why_still_open: No labelled cross-source benchmark exists, so a fuzzy auto-accept threshold remains intentionally unset.
closure_requires: A measured precision and recall decision before enabling fuzzy auto-accept
